```yaml
name: AI Docs Review Command

# Triggered manually via the slash command `/ai-docs-review`
on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      # Pull request number to review
      pr:
        description: 'Pull request number to review'
        required: false
      # Repository (unused, kept for dispatcher compatibility)
      repo:
        description: 'Repository (unused)'
        required: false
      # Git reference (unused, kept for dispatcher compatibility)
      gitref:
        description: 'Git reference (unused)'
        required: false

jobs:
  ai-docs-review:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      # --------------------------------------------------------------------
      # Security model documentation
      # --------------------------------------------------------------------
      - name: Security model documentation
        run: |
          echo "This workflow runs with the permissions of the repository's default token."
          echo "It only accesses the PR that triggered it via the workflow_dispatch input."
          echo "No write permissions are required beyond creating comments."

      # --------------------------------------------------------------------
      # Input definitions with explanatory comments
      # --------------------------------------------------------------------
      # (Inputs are defined in the `on.workflow_dispatch.inputs` section above)

      # --------------------------------------------------------------------
      # Input validation step
      # --------------------------------------------------------------------
      - name: Validate inputs
        id: validate
        continue-on-error: true
        run: |
          if [[ -z "${{ inputs.pr }}" ]]; then
            echo "Missing required input: pr"
            exit 1
          fi

      # --------------------------------------------------------------------
      # Error comment posting if validation fails
      # --------------------------------------------------------------------
      - name: Post error comment if validation fails
        if: ${{ failure() }}
        uses: peter-evans/create-or-update-comment@a35cf36e5301d70b76f316e867e7788a55a31dae
        with:
          token: ${{ github.token }}
          issue-number: ${{ inputs.pr }}
          body: |
            :x: **Error**: Missing required input `pr`. Please provide a pull request number.

      # --------------------------------------------------------------------
      # Checkout using refs/pull/${{ inputs.pr }}/head
      # --------------------------------------------------------------------
      - name: Checkout PR
        uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683
        with:
          ref: refs/pull/${{ inputs.pr }}/head
          fetch-depth: 0

      # --------------------------------------------------------------------
      # File change detection with pagination
      # --------------------------------------------------------------------
      - name: Get changed files
        id: changed_files
        run: |
          gh api --paginate /repos/${{ github.repository }}/pulls/${{ inputs.pr }}/files -q '.[].filename' > files.txt
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}

      - name: Check for docs changes
        id: docs_changed
        run: |
          if grep -qE 'docs/' files.txt; then
            echo "docs_changed=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          else
            echo "docs_changed=false" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          fi

      # --------------------------------------------------------------------
      # Start/skip comment posting
      # --------------------------------------------------------------------
      - name: Post start comment
        if: steps.docs_changed.outputs.docs_changed == 'true'
        uses: peter-evans/create-or-update-comment@a35cf36e5301d70b76f316e867e7788a55a31dae
        with:
          token: ${{ github.token }}
          issue-number: ${{ inputs.pr }}
          body: |
            :hourglass_flowing_sand: **AI Docs Review** started. Please wait...

      - name: Post skip comment
        if: steps.docs_changed.outputs.docs_changed == 'false'
        uses: peter-evans/create-or-update-comment@a35cf36e5301d70b76f316e867e7788a55a31dae
        with:
          token: ${{ github.token }}
          issue-number: ${{ inputs.pr }}
          body: |
            :white_check_mark: No documentation changes detected. Skipping AI review.

      # --------------------------------------------------------------------
      # Devin action invocation
      # --------------------------------------------------------------------
      - name: Create GitHub App token
        id: app_token
        uses: actions/create-github-app-token@67018539274d69449ef7c02e8e71183d1719ab42
        with:
          app-id: ${{ secrets.GH_APP_ID }}
          private-key: ${{ secrets.GH_APP_PRIVATE_KEY }}

      - name: Run AI docs review
        if: steps.docs_changed.outputs.docs_changed == 'true'
        uses: aaronsteers/devin-action@0d74d6d9ff1b16ada5966dc31af53a9d155759f4
        with:
          playbook: !connectordocs-pr-review
          repo: ${{ github.repository }}
          pr: ${{ inputs.pr }}
          token: ${{ steps.app_token.outputs.token }}
```
